reader.notes: The embedded sign is punched into the first or last digit by ZonedSign tables and the S adds no character position; the valid set is derived from the same tables (IsSignCharacter) for NUMERIC and checked reads. Behaviour is edition-independent and matches the documented latitude DOC-A.1-178.
